question.text: You are given that  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>Li</mi><mprescripts></mprescripts><mn>3</mn><mn>7</mn></mmultiscripts><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0160</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mo>,</mo></math>Mass of Mass of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>He</mi><mprescripts></mprescripts><mn>2</mn><mn>4</mn></mmultiscripts><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0026</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math> and Mass of  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>He</mi><mprescripts></mprescripts><mn>1</mn><mn>1</mn></mmultiscripts><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0079</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> When <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>Li</mi><mprescripts></mprescripts><mn>3</mn><mn>7</mn></mmultiscripts></math> is converted into <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msubsup><mrow></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>4</mn></msubsup></math> He by proton capture, the energy liberated, (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>kWh</mi></math> ), is : [Mass of nucleon <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mi>GeV</mi><mo>/</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>]
